source_text: I think the missing first phase is borrowed adulthood. Before you can reliably become the inner parent, you may need to experience, imagine, imitate, and practice one adult function with help. You receive care, observe how it is given, participate in it, initiate a small part yourself, and gradually internalize it.
candidate_text: I think the missing first phase is borrowed adulthood. Before you can reliably become the inner parent, you may need to borrow one adult function first. Maybe you experience it with somebody, maybe you imagine it, maybe you copy what you've seen. Then you practice some of it with help and start doing little pieces yourself. Over time, you don't have to borrow as much.
